spec.name: us_federal_income_tax_2026
spec.summary: US federal individual income tax on Form 1040 for tax year 2025 or 2026: AGI, standard or itemized deduction, the simplified QBI deduction, bracket tax with the 0%/15%/20% rates on qualified dividends and long-term gains, the child tax credit, self-employment tax, Additional Medicare Tax and net investment income tax, plus the estimated-tax safe harbour and due dates. Refuses the alternative minimum tax when it cannot be shown to be zero, QBI above the threshold, the child tax credit above its phase-out start, and 2025 married filing separately.

filing_status.description: filing status at the end of the year (a qualifying surviving spouse is not covered)

w2_social_security_wages.description: USD, Form W-2 box 3. Left out, it is taken as equal to wages. Used only for the self-employment tax wage base

w2_medicare_wages.description: USD, Form W-2 box 5. Left out, it is taken as equal to wages. Used only for the Additional Medicare Tax

self_employment_net_profit.description: USD, Schedule C line 31 net profit (all Schedule C businesses together; a loss is not covered)

self_employed_retirement_and_health_dedu.description: USD, Schedule 1 lines 16 and 17 for that business: SEP, SIMPLE or solo 401(k) deduction plus self-employed health insurance. They reduce AGI and QBI

other_adjustments.description: USD, other Schedule 1 adjustments not tied to the business (HSA, IRA, student loan interest, educator expenses)

ordinary_dividends.description: USD, ordinary dividends (line 3b), qualified dividends included

qualified_dividends.description: USD, qualified dividends (line 3a), part of ordinary_dividends

short_term_capital_gains.description: USD, net short-term capital gain (taxed as ordinary income). If short-term losses exceed short-term gains, subtract the net loss from long_term_capital_gains and enter 0

long_term_capital_gains.description: USD, net long-term capital gain on assets held more than one year, after any net short-term loss, with no 28% collectibles or 25% section 1250 gain. A net capital loss is not covered

other_ordinary_income.description: USD, other taxable income that is not investment income (unemployment compensation, taxable pensions and IRA distributions, prizes). Rents, royalties and passive income are not covered

itemized_deductions.description: USD, Schedule A total after the SALT cap and every other Schedule A limit. Left out, the standard deduction is used; given, the larger of the two is used

itemized_state_and_local_taxes.description: USD, the state and local taxes included in itemized_deductions (after the cap). Used only to show the alternative minimum tax is zero; left out, all itemized deductions are treated as taxes (the cautious reading)

cash_charitable_gifts.description: USD, cash gifts to public charities. Used only in 2026 when the standard deduction is taken (up to USD 1,000, or USD 2,000 married filing jointly); an itemizer includes gifts in itemized_deductions

dependents_under_17.description: qualifying children under 17 at the end of the year, each with a social security number (child tax credit)

materially_participates.description: 2026 only, asked when it changes the answer: the taxpayer materially participates in the Schedule C business (for the USD 400 minimum QBI deduction)

prior_year_tax.description: USD, total tax on last year's return (Form 1040 line 24), for the estimated-tax safe harbour. Left out, no safe harbour is computed

prior_year_agi.description: USD, last year's AGI (Form 1040 line 11b), needed with prior_year_tax for the 100% or 110% test

tax_year.description: the tax year the question is about. This engine has figures for 2025 and 2026 only; any other year is refused

outputs.ordinary_tax: USD, bracket tax on ordinary taxable income
outputs.preferential_tax: USD, tax on qualified dividends and long-term gains at 0%/15%/20%
outputs.estimated_tax: required annual payment, instalment and due dates (when prior_year_tax is given)

rules.name: QBI_SIMPLIFIED_METHOD
rules.section: QBI deduction: which form, and the thresholds for 2025
rules.quote:
At or below the threshold, a specified service business (for example consulting) is treated as a qualified business, and there is no limit based on W-2 wages or property.
Form 8995 computes 20% of QBI, then caps it at 20% of (taxable income before QBI − net capital gain, including qualified dividends).

rules.name: QBI_DEFINITION
rules.quote: "Taxable income before the QBI deduction" = line 11a − line 12e − line 13b. ... QBI itself is net profit reduced by the deductible half of SE tax, the health insurance deduction and the retirement contribution attributable to the business.

rules.name: QBI_MINIMUM_2026
rules.quote: Starting in 2026, an "applicable taxpayer" gets a minimum QBI deduction of $400. An applicable taxpayer has at least $1,000 of qualified business income, in total, from active trades or businesses in which the taxpayer materially participates. The deduction is the larger of the normal computation and $400.

rules.name: CAPITAL_GAIN_STACKING
rules.quote:
Qualified dividends go in the 0%/15%/20% group.
Stack. Ordinary taxable income fills the brackets first, and the preferential gain sits on top of it. The 0% and 15% ceilings are measured against total taxable income, not against the gain alone. Use the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet.

rules.name: AMT_COMPUTATION_STEPS
rules.quote: AMT computation steps — 1. Start with regular taxable income (Line 15). 2. Add back the standard deduction (if claimed). 3. Add AMT adjustments and preferences (Form 6251 Lines 2a-2t). 4. Subtract the AMT exemption (with phaseout if AMTI > threshold). 5. Apply 26%/28% AMT rates. 6. Subtract AMT foreign tax credit. 7. Compare to regular tax.

rules.name: SAFE_HARBOUR_2026
rules.section: Estimated tax and the Form 2210 penalty
rules.quote:
Estimated tax is required for 2026 when ... the smaller of 90% of the 2026 tax and 100% of the 2025 tax. The 2025 return must cover 12 months.
Use 110% instead of 100% if 2025 AGI (line 11b) was more than $150,000 ($75,000 if filing separately for 2026).

rules.name: SAFE_HARBOUR_2025

Current — 90% of current-year tax
AGI > $150,000 ($75,000 MFS) | 110% of prior year tax
Required = lesser of: Method A (current year): 90% of TY2025 tax; Method B (prior year): 100% of TY2024 tax (110% if AGI > $150K / $75K MFS)
